 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B><A NAME="otv10518_4"></A>LEGAL INFORMATION </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:14pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Legal address </U></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL">Macacha G&uuml;emes 515 - Ciudad Aut&oacute;noma
de Buenos Aires, Argentina. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:14pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Fiscal year </U></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL">No.&nbsp;49
beginning on January&nbsp;1, 2025. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:14pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Main business of the Company </U></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The Company&#146;s purpose shall be to perform, on its own, through third parties or in association with third parties, the survey, exploration and
exploitation of liquid and/or gaseous hydrocarbon fields and other minerals, as well as the industrialization, transportation and commercialization of these products and their direct and indirect <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">by-products,</FONT>
including petrochemical products, chemical products, whether derived from hydrocarbons or not, and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-fossil</FONT> fuels, biofuels and their components, as well as the generation of electrical energy through the
use of hydrocarbons, to which effect it may manufacture, use, purchase, sell, exchange, import or export them. It shall also be the Company&#146;s purpose the rendering, on its own, through a controlled company or in association with third parties,
of telecommunications services in all forms and modalities authorized by the legislation in force after applying for the relevant licenses as required by the regulatory framework, as well as the production, industrialization, processing,
commercialization, conditioning, transportation and stockpiling of grains and products derived from grains, as well as any other activity complementary to its industrial and commercial business or any activity which may be necessary to attain its
object. To better achieve these purposes, it may set up, become associated with or have an interest in any public or private entity domiciled in Argentina or abroad, within the limits set forth in the Bylaws. </P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL; " ALIGN="justify"><B>BASIS OF PREPARATION OF THE CONDENSED INTERIM CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS </B></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B>2.a) Applicable accounting framework </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The condensed interim
consolidated financial statements of the Company for the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> period ended June&nbsp;30, 2025, are presented in accordance with IAS 34 &#147;Interim financial reporting&#148;. Therefore, they should be
read together with the annual consolidated financial statements of the Company as of December&nbsp;31, 2024 (&#147;annual consolidated financial statements&#148;) presented in U.S. dollars and in accordance with IFRS Accounting Standards as issued
by the IASB. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">These condensed interim consolidated financial statements corresponding to the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> period
ended June&nbsp;30, 2025, are unaudited. The Company believes they include all necessary adjustments to reasonably present the results of each period on a basis consistent with the audited annual consolidated financial statements. Net Income for the
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> period ended June&nbsp;30, 2025, does not necessarily reflect the proportion of the Group&#146;s full-year net income. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:10pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B>2.b) Material accounting policies </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The material accounting
policies are described in Note 2.b) to the annual consolidated financial statements. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The accounting policies adopted in the preparation of these
condensed interim consolidated financial statements are consistent with those used in the preparation of the annual consolidated financial statements, except for the valuation policy for income tax detailed in Note 19. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:10pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Functional currency </U></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">As mentioned in Note
2.b.1) to the annual consolidated financial statements, YPF has defined the U.S. dollar as its functional currency. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The consolidated financial
statements used by YPF for statutory, legal and regulatory purposes in Argentina are those in pesos and filed with the CNV and approved by the Board of Directors and authorized to be issued on August&nbsp;7, 2025. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:10pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Business combinations </U></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The Group analyzes
whether the assets acquired and liabilities assumed in a purchase transaction qualify as a business combination in accordance with IFRS 3 &#147;Business combinations&#148;. Business combinations are accounted for using the acquisition method, which
requires, among others, the recognition and measurement at fair value of the identifiable assets acquired, the liabilities assumed and any <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-controlling</FONT> interest. The excess of the consideration transferred
over such fair value is recognized as goodwill and the shortfall as a gain in profit or loss for the period. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">When the assets acquired are not a
business, the Group accounts for the transaction as the acquisition of an asset. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="font-size:50pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:7pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="right">HORACIO DANIEL MAR&Iacute;N </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:7pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="right">President&#8195;&#8195;&#8195;&#8195;&#8195; </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><B>2. BASIS OF PREPARATION OF THE CONDENSED INTERIM CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS (cont.) </B></P>
<p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Adoption of new standards and interpretations effective as from January&nbsp;1, 2025 </U></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The Company has adopted all new and revised standards and interpretations issued by the IASB, relevant to its operations which are of mandatory and
effective application as of June&nbsp;30, 2025, as described in Note 2.b.14) to the annual consolidated financial statements. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The adoption of the
amendments mentioned in Note 2.b.14) &#147;Amendments to IAS 21&#151;Lack of exchangeability&#148; section to the annual consolidated financial statements has not had a significant effect on these condensed interim consolidated financial statements.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Standards and interpretations issued by the IASB whose application is not mandatory at the closing date of these condensed interim consolidated
financial statements and have not been adopted by the Group </U></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">In accordance with Article 1, Chapter III, Title IV of the CNV rules, the early
application of the IFRS and/or their amendments is not permitted for issuers filing financial statements with the CNV, unless specifically admitted by such agency. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B>2.c) Significant estimates and key sources of estimation uncertainty </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">In preparing the financial statements at a certain date, the Group is required to make estimates and assessments affecting the amount of assets and
liabilities recorded and the contingent assets and liabilities disclosed at such date, as well as income and expenses recognized in the fiscal year or period. Actual future profit or loss might differ from the estimates and assessments made at the
date of preparation of these condensed interim consolidated financial statements. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The assumptions relating to the future and other key sources of
uncertainty about the estimates made for the preparation of these condensed interim consolidated financial statements are consistent with those used by the Group in the preparation of the annual consolidated financial statements, which are disclosed
in Note 2.c) to the annual consolidated financial statements. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B>2.d) Comparative information </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Amounts and other financial information corresponding to the fiscal year ended December&nbsp;31, 2024 and for the
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> period ended June&nbsp;30, 2024 are an integral part of these condensed interim consolidated financial statements and are intended to be read only in relation to these financial statements. Likewise,
changes have been made to the comparative figures in Notes 6 and 26 as mentioned in Note 6. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B><A NAME="otv10518_11"></A>3.</B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL; " ALIGN="justify"><B>SEASONALITY OF OPERATIONS </B></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Historically, the Group&#146;s results have been subject to seasonal fluctuations throughout the year, particularly as a result of the increase in natural
gas sales during the winter driven by the increased demand in the residential segment. Consequently, the Group is subject to seasonal fluctuations in its sales volumes and prices, with higher sales of natural gas during the winter at higher prices.
</P> <P STYLE="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The most relevant acquisitions and disposals of companies that took place during the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> period ended
June&nbsp;30, 2025 are described below: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:10pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Acquisition of Mobil Argentina S.A. </U></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On December&nbsp;17, 2024, the Company entered into a share purchase and sale agreement with ExxonMobil Argentina Upstream B.V., ExxonMobil Exploration
and Production Gemini B.V., and QatarEnergy Argentina Holdings LLC (collectively, the &#147;Sellers&#148;) whereby, subject to the fulfillment of closing conditions set forth in such agreement, YPF acquired 100% of the shares and capital stock of
Mobil Argentina S.A. (&#147;MASA&#148;). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">MASA owns 54.45% of Sierra Chata unconventional exploitation concession in the Province of Neuqu&eacute;n.
Pampa Energ&iacute;a S.A., operator of such concession, owns the remaining working interest. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="font-size:90pt; margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><B>4. ACQUISITIONS AND DISPOSALS (cont.) </B></P> <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On January&nbsp;29, 2025 (&#147;acquisition date&#148;), after the fulfillment of the closing

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL; " ALIGN="justify"><B>FINANCIAL RISK MANAGEMENT </B></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The Group&#146;s activities expose it to a variety of financial risks: Market risk (including exchange rate risk, interest rate risk, and price risk),
liquidity risk and credit risk. Within the Group, risk management functions are conducted in relation to financial risks associated to financial instruments to which the Group is exposed during a certain period or as of a specific date. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">During the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> period ended June&nbsp;30, 2025, there were no significant changes in the administration or
policies of risk management implemented by the Group as described in Note 4 to the annual consolidated financial statements. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:ARIAL; font-size:9pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>&#149;</B></TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="justify" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:ARIAL; font-size:9pt"><B>Liquidity risk management </B></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Most of the Group&#146;s loans contain market-standard covenants for contracts of this nature, which include financial covenants in respect of the
Group&#146;s leverage ratio and debt service coverage ratio, and events of defaults triggered by materially adverse judgements, among others. See Notes 17, 33 and 34 to the annual consolidated financial statements and Notes 18 and 34. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The Group monitors compliance with covenants on a quarterly basis. As of June&nbsp;30, 2025, the Group is in compliance with its covenants. </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:ARIAL; font-size:9pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B><A NAME="otv10518_14"></A>6.</B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL; " ALIGN="justify"><B>BUSINESS SEGMENT INFORMATION </B></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The different business segments in which the Group&#146;s organization is structured consider the different activities from which the Group can obtain
revenues and incur expenses. Such organizational structure is based on the way in which the chief decision maker analyzes the main operating and financial magnitudes for making decisions about resource allocation and performance assessment, also
considering the business strategy of the Group. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Business segment information is presented consistently with the manner of reporting the information
used by the chief decision maker to allocate resources and assess business segment performance. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:7pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="right">HORACIO DANIEL MAR&Iacute;N </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><B>6. BUSINESS SEGMENT INFORMATION (cont.) </B></P> <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">As of the current fiscal year, as a consequence of the organizational structure changes in which the New
Energies Vice Presidency was created and the Gas and Power Vice Presidency and the Downstream Vice Presidency were reformulated as the LNG and Integrated Gas Vice Presidency and the Midstream and Downstream Vice Presidency, respectively, the
complete management scope of these new business units was determined. On January&nbsp;1, 2025, these organizational changes resulted in a modification of the composition of the business segments according to how the chief decision maker allocates
resources and assesses the performance of these business segments, creating the New Energies business segment and readjusting the composition and definition of the businesses of the remaining business segments. The changes in the business segments
had no impact on the CGUs defined in Note 2.b.5) to the annual consolidated financial statements. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">As aforementioned and in Note 5 to the annual
consolidated financial statements, the comparative information for the fiscal year ended December&nbsp;31, 2024 and the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> period ended June&nbsp;30, 2024 has been restated. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The business segments structure is organized as follows: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:8pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:ARIAL; font-size:9pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>&#149;</B></TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="justify" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:ARIAL; font-size:9pt"><B>Upstream </B></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The Upstream business segment performs all activities related to the exploration and exploitation of hydrocarbon fields and production of
crude oil and natural gas. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On July&nbsp;1, 2024, certain assets related to the production of frac sand for well drilling/fracking
purposes, which were formerly included in the Upstream business segment, were assigned to Central Administration and Others. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Its
revenues are mainly derived from: (i)&nbsp;the sale of the produced crude oil to the Midstream and Downstream business segment; (ii)&nbsp;the sale of the produced natural gas to the LNG and Integrated Gas business segment; and (iii)&nbsp;the sale of
the natural gas retained in plant to the Midstream and Downstream business segment. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">It incurs all costs related to the aforementioned
activities. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:8pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:ARIAL; font-size:9pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>&#149;</B></TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="justify" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:ARIAL; font-size:9pt"><B>Midstream and Downstream </B></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The Midstream and Downstream business segment performs activities related to: (i)&nbsp;the refining, transportation and commercialization
of refined products; (ii)&nbsp;the production, transportation and commercialization of petrochemical products; (iii)&nbsp;the transportation and commercialization of crude oil; and (iv)&nbsp;the commercialization of specialties for the agribusiness
industry and of grains and their <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">by-products.</FONT> </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On January&nbsp;1, 2025, as a consequence of
the organizational changes described above, the assets related to the natural gas transportation, the conditioning and processing of natural gas retained in plant for the separation and fractionation of gasoline, propane and butane, the storage of
the produced natural gas, and the commercial and technical operation of the LNG regasification terminal in Escobar, which were formerly included in the Gas and Power business segment, were assigned to the Midstream and Downstream business segment.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Its revenues are mainly derived from the sale of crude oil, refined and petrochemical products, and specialties for agribusiness
industry and grains and their <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">by-products,</FONT> through the businesses of B2C (Retail), B2B (Commercial Networks, Industries, Transportation, Aviation, Agro, Lubricants and Specialties), LPG, Chemicals,
International Trade and Transportation and Sales to Companies. In addition, it obtains revenues from midstream oil, midstream gas and natural gas storage operations and the provision of LNG regasification services. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">It incurs all costs related to the aforementioned activities, including the purchase of: (i)&nbsp;crude oil from the Upstream business
segment and third parties; (ii)&nbsp;natural gas to be consumed in the refinery and petrochemical industrial complexes from the LNG and Integrated Gas business segment; and (iii)&nbsp;natural gas retained in plant from the Upstream business segment.

<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The LNG and Integrated Gas business segment performs activities related to: (i)&nbsp;natural gas commercialization to third parties and to

produced natural gas, and the commercial and technical operation of the LNG regasification terminal in Escobar, which were formerly included in the Gas and Power business segment, were assigned to the Midstream and Downstream business segment.
Furthermore, the assets related to the distribution of natural gas through our subsidiary Metrogas, the generation of conventional thermal electric power and renewable energy, and the production, storage, distribution and sale of fertilizers through
our investments in associates and joint ventures, which were formerly included in the Gas and Power business segment, were assigned to the New Energies business segment. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Its revenues are mainly derived from the commercialization of natural gas as producers to third parties and to the Midstream and
Downstream and the New Energies business segments. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">It incurs all costs related to the aforementioned activities, including the
purchase of natural gas from the Upstream business segment. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:8pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On January&nbsp;1, 2025, as a consequence of the organizational changes described above, the New Energies Vice Presidency was created and
during the current fiscal year the complete management scope of this new business unit was determined. As of that date, the assets related to the distribution of natural gas through our subsidiary Metrogas, the generation of conventional thermal
electric power and renewable energy and the production, storage, distribution and sale of fertilizers through our investments in associates and joint ventures, which were formerly included in the Gas and Power business segment, were assigned to the

performs activities related to: (i)&nbsp;the definition and development of the new energy portfolio; (ii)&nbsp;the definition and development of sustainability and energy transitions programs; (iii)&nbsp;the distribution of natural gas through our
subsidiary Metrogas; and (iv)&nbsp;the provision of research and development services of technology applied to the hydrocarbon industry through our subsidiary <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Y-TEC.</FONT> Furthermore, through our investments in
associates and joint ventures, the New Energies business segment performs activities related to: (i)&nbsp;the generation of conventional thermal electric power and renewable energy; and (ii)&nbsp;the production, storage, distribution and sale of
fertilizers. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Its revenues are mainly derived from the sale of natural gas through our subsidiary Metrogas. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">It incurs all costs related to the aforementioned activities, including the purchase of natural gas from the LNG and Integrated Gas
business segment. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:120pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="font-size:36pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt; margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

the transfer of 100% of the rights and obligations of YPF in such exploitation concessions in favor of Bentia and Ingenier&iacute;a SIMA S.A. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL"><U>Al Norte de la

<P STYLE="margin-top:10pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B><A NAME="otv10518_27"></A>19. INCOME TAX </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:10pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">According to IAS 34,
income tax expense is recognized in each interim period based on the best estimate of the effective income tax rate expected as of the closing date of these condensed interim consolidated financial statements, considering the tax criteria that the
Group assumes to apply during the fiscal year. If the estimate of such rate is modified based on new elements of judgment, the income tax expense could require adjustments in subsequent periods. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Uncertain tax positions on income tax treatments in accordance with the guidelines of IFRIC 23 &#147;Uncertainty over income tax treatments&#148; (see
Note 2.c) &#147;Income tax and deferred taxes&#148; section to the annual consolidated financial statements), and its effects, are described in Note 18 to the annual consolidated financial statements. </P>

</TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B><A NAME="otv10518_40"></A>32. SHAREHOLDERS&#146; EQUITY </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">As of June&nbsp;30, 2025, the Company&#146;s capital amounts to 3,922 and treasury shares amount to 11 represented by 393,312,793 book-entry shares of
common stock and divided into four classes of shares (A, B, C and D), with a par value of 10 pesos and 1 vote per share. These shares are fully subscribed, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">paid-in</FONT> and authorized for stock exchange listing.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">As of June&nbsp;30, 2025, there are 3,764 Class&nbsp;A outstanding shares. As long as any Class&nbsp;A share remains outstanding, the affirmative
vote of the Argentine Government is required for: (i)&nbsp;mergers; (ii) acquisitions of more than 50% of YPF shares in an agreed or hostile bid; (iii)&nbsp;transfers of all the YPF&#146;s exploitation and exploration rights; (iv)&nbsp;the voluntary
dissolution of YPF; (v)&nbsp;change of corporate and/or tax address outside Argentina; or (vi)&nbsp;make an acquisition that would result in the purchaser holding 15% or more of the Company&#146;s capital stock, or 20% or more of the outstanding
Class&nbsp;D shares. Items (iii)&nbsp;and (iv) also require prior approval by the Argentine Congress. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">During the
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> periods ended June&nbsp;30, 2025 and 2024, the Company has not repurchased any of its own shares. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On April&nbsp;30, 2025, the General Shareholders&#146; Meeting was held, which approved the statutory financial statements of YPF (see Note 2.b))
corresponding to the year ended on December&nbsp;31, 2024 and, additionally, approved the following in relation to the retained earnings: (i)&nbsp;completely release the reserve for purchase of treasury shares and the reserve for investments;
(ii)&nbsp;allocate the amount of 34,205&nbsp;million of pesos (US$ 33 million) to appropriate a reserve for purchase of treasury shares; and (iii)&nbsp;allocate the amount of 6,787,343&nbsp;million of pesos (US$ 6,587 million) to appropriate a
reserve for investments. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B><A NAME="otv10518_41"></A>33. EARNINGS PER SHARE </B></P>

granted a temporary administrative stay of the turnover orders pending resolution of the stay motions. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">YPF is not a party to the aforementioned
turnover proceedings. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">With respect to the appeal of the final judgment issued on September&nbsp;15, 2023, the Court of Appeals has proposed holding

November&nbsp;15, 2024, including regarding YPF. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">YPF will continue to defend itself in accordance with the applicable legal procedures and available

distribution </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Tariff schemes and tariff renegotiations </U></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">ENARGAS, through several resolutions, approved the transition tariff schemes to be applied by Metrogas until the rates resulting from the RQT came into
force in accordance with the provisions of Decree No.&nbsp;55/2023. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On April&nbsp;30, 2025, ENARGAS Resolution No.&nbsp;257/2025 was published, which
approved: (i)&nbsp;the RQT corresponding to Metrogas; (ii)&nbsp;the segmentation of residential users; (iii)&nbsp;the investment plans for the five-year period 2025&#151;2030; and (iv)&nbsp;the initial tariff scheme and the schemes of rates and
charges corresponding to Metrogas effective as from May&nbsp;1, 2025. The increase expected as a result of the RQT process will be effective in 31 consecutive monthly increases, which recognizes a cost for the deferral at a real weighted average
cost of the capital employed rate in pesos of 7.64% and establishes that the increase in distribution tariffs for May 2025 applicable to residential users and general service customers will be 3%. The application of the remaining increase derived
from the RQT will be completed in the remaining 30 installments, plus the recognition of the cost of the aforementioned deferral. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On June&nbsp;5,
2025, SE Resolution No.&nbsp;241/2025 was published, which established that the transportation and distribution tariffs will be adjusted on a monthly basis according to the variations in the indexes established by ENARGAS in the RQT, which
correspond to the variation in equal parts of the IPC and the Internal Wholesale Price Index (&#147;IPIM&#148; by its acronym in Spanish) published by the INDEC. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On June&nbsp;6, 2025, ENARGAS Resolution No.&nbsp;363/2025 was published, which approved: (i)&nbsp;the methodology for the monthly adjustment of tariffs;
and (ii)&nbsp;the tariff charts to be applied by Metrogas effective as from June&nbsp;6, 2025. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">ENARGAS, through several resolutions, approved the
tariff schemes to be applied by Metrogas on a monthly basis within the framework of the RQT in accordance with the provisions of ENARGAS Resolution No.&nbsp;363/2025. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Procedure for the compensation of the lower revenues received by natural gas distributors from their users </U></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On January&nbsp;31, 2025, SE Resolution No.&nbsp;24/2025 repealed as from February&nbsp;1, 2025 MINEM Resolution No.
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">508-E/2017,</FONT> which established the procedure to compensate natural gas distributors for lower revenues due to benefits and/or bonuses and higher costs of UNG and unified the compensation mechanisms for lower
revenues received as a consequence of the application of incentive programs involving bonuses on the price of natural gas in the PIST. The amounts to be compensated will be deducted from the amounts to be paid by distributors to natural gas
producers and will be directly compensated by the SE through the Plan GasAr 2023-2028. </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B>36. MAIN REGULATIONS (cont.) </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B>36.d.2) Regulatory framework associated with electric power generation </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On July&nbsp;7, 2025, Decree No.&nbsp;450/2025 was published, which approves the following amendments to the Regulatory Framework associated with electric
power generation: (i)&nbsp;maximum competition and free contracting is guaranteed to generators; (ii)&nbsp;supply contracts will be freely negotiated between the parties; (iii)&nbsp;the figure of &#147;storer&#148; is introduced as the owner of
energy storage facilities; (iv)&nbsp;the figure of &#147;free user&#148; is introduced, who, together with large users, may contract independently and for own consumption the energy supply; (v)&nbsp;allows the PEN to authorize generators,
distributors and/or large users to build, at their exclusive cost and to satisfy their own needs, a line and/or extension of the transmission grid, which will not provide a public transportation service; and (vi)&nbsp;the extensions of the Argentine
Electricity Grid (&#147;SADI&#148;, by its acronym in Spanish) may be of free initiative and at the own risk of whoever executes them. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>CAMMESA
</U></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The SE, through complementary notes to SE Resolution No.&nbsp;21/2025, informed to CAMMESA of the &#147;Guidelines for the Standardization of the
MEM and its Progressive Adaptation&#148;, which detail the modifications foreseen for the management of fuels, the determination of prices and the operation of the term market and the spot market are detailed. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B>36.d.3) Decree No.&nbsp;55/2023 &#147;Emergency in the National Energy Sector&#148; </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On June&nbsp;2, 2025, Decree No.&nbsp;370/2025 was published extending the emergency of the national energy sector until July&nbsp;9, 2026. It also
provided for the extension of the intervention of ENRE and ENARGAS until July&nbsp;9, 2026 or until the constitution, commencement and appointment of the members of the Board of Directors of the National Gas and Electricity Regulatory Agency. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On July&nbsp;7, 2025, Decree No.&nbsp;452/2025 was published, establishing the National Gas and Electricity Regulatory Agency and granting a term of 180
days for its commencement of operations. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B>36.e) Incentive programs for hydrocarbon production </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Updates to the regulatory framework described in Note 36.d) to the annual consolidated financial statements for the
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> period ended June&nbsp;30, 2025, are described below: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B>36.e.1) Incentive programs for natural gas production
</B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Plan for Reinsurance and Promotion of Federal Hydrocarbon Production Domestic Self-Sufficiency, Exports, Imports Substitution and the
Expansion of the Transportation System for all Hydrocarbon Basins in the Country 2023-2028 (&#147;Plan GasAr 2023-2028&#148;) </U></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The SE, through
several resolutions, approves the natural gas prices at the PIST to be passed-through to <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">end-users</FONT> in connection with current contracts entered into within the framework of the Plan GasAr 2023-2028. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The SE, through complementary notes to SE Resolution No.&nbsp;21/2025, instructed CAMMESA to apply a new order of priority for the dispatch of natural gas
and established that the acquisition of fuels will be carried out through 2 modalities: (i)&nbsp;auctions by CAMMESA for the purchase of spot volumes; and (ii)&nbsp;bids by which generators auction volumes with a maximum reference price based on
round 4.2. of the Plan GasAr 2023-2028. </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B>36. MAIN REGULATIONS (cont.) </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On April&nbsp;11, 2025, the Argentine Government announced measures to loosen the foreign exchange regime and reinforce the monetary framework. By virtue
of this, the BCRA implemented a new foreign exchange regime in which certain restrictions to access the Foreign Exchange Market were eliminated. The following are the main measures: (i)&nbsp;the &#147;crawling peg&#148; adjustment mechanism is
eliminated and the dollar exchange rate in the Foreign Exchange Market may fluctuate in a range between 1,000 pesos and 1,400 pesos, whose limits will be increased at a rate of 1% per month; (ii)&nbsp;the &#147;blend&#148; dollar was eliminated (see
Note 36.i) &#147;Export Increase Program&#148; section); (iii) certain foreign exchange restrictions to individuals for the purchase of foreign currency were eliminated; (iv)&nbsp;access to the Foreign Exchange Market is allowed without prior
approval of the BCRA for the payment of dividends to <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-resident</FONT> shareholders accrued as from fiscal years beginning on or after January&nbsp;1, 2025; and (v)&nbsp;the terms for the payment of foreign trade
transactions are flexibilized, eliminating the schedule established by the BCRA for access to the Foreign Exchange Market without prior approval for the payment of imports of goods with customs entry registration as from December&nbsp;13, 2023 and
of services rendered and/or accrued as from such date. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Export Increase Program </U></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On April&nbsp;14, 2025, Decree No.&nbsp;269/2025 repealed the Export Increase Program and as from such date the proceeds from the export of goods and
services, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">pre-export</FONT> financings, post- export financings and advance payments must be settled 100% through the Foreign Exchange Market within a general term of 20 days. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B>36.j) Decree of Necessity and Urgency (&#147;DNU&#148; by its acronym in Spanish) No.&nbsp;70/2023 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">During the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> period ended June&nbsp;30, 2025, there were no significant updates to the regulatory
framework described in Note 36.i) to the annual consolidated financial statements. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B>36.k) Law of Bases and Starting Points for the Freedom of Argentines
No.&nbsp;27,742 (&#147;Bases Law&#148;) and Regulatory Decree No 1,057/2024 (&#147;Decree No 1,057/2024&#148;) </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">During the <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> period ended June&nbsp;30, 2025, there were no significant updates to the regulatory framework described in Note 36.j) to the annual consolidated financial statements. </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B><A NAME="otv10518_46"></A>38. EMPLOYEE BENEFIT PLANS AND SIMILAR OBLIGATIONS </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Note 38 to the annual consolidated financial statements describes the main characteristics and accounting treatment for employee benefit plans and similar
obligations implemented by the Group. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Retirement plan</U> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The amount charged to expense related to the Retirement Plan was 2 and 2 for the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> periods ended
June&nbsp;30, 2025 and 2024, respectively. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Short-term benefit programs</U> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The amount charged to expense related to the short-term benefit programs was 89 and 97 for the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> periods
ended June&nbsp;30, 2025 and 2024, respectively. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Share-based benefit plans</U> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">As of June&nbsp;30, 2025, there are 4.6&nbsp;million number of PSARs outstanding with and a weighted average fair value of US$ 17.24 per PSARs. The amount
charged to expense in relation with Value Generation Plan was 1 and 2 for the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> periods ended June&nbsp;30, 2025 and 2024, respectively. As of December&nbsp;31, 2024, weighted average fair value was
US$ 28.6 per PSARs. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The amount charged to expense in relation with the remaining share-based benefit plans was 5 and 2 to be settled in equity
instruments, for the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> periods ended June&nbsp;30, 2025 and 2024, respectively, and 9 to be settled in cash, for the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> period ended June&nbsp;30, 2024.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Note 2.b.11) to the annual consolidated financial statements describes the accounting policies for share-based benefit plans. Repurchases of
treasury shares are disclosed in Note 32. </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B><A NAME="otv10518_47"></A>39. SUBSEQUENT EVENTS </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Vaca Muerta Sur Project guarantee</U> </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On
July&nbsp;8, 2025, our associated VMOS signed an international syndicated loan for 2.000 to finance the construction of the Vaca Muerta Sur Project. As guarantee for the obligations assumed in this loan, VMOS&#146;s shareholders, including YPF, have
granted a fiduciary assignment of their VMOS&#146;s shares as collateral for such financing, which will remain in force until the completion of the project. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Issuance of NO</U> </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On July&nbsp;22, 2025, the
Company issued in the local market Class&nbsp;XXXVIII and Class&nbsp;XXXIX NO for a nominal amount of 250 maturing in July 2027 and 167 maturing in July 2030, respectively. Class&nbsp;XXXVIII NO accrue and pay interest quarterly at a fixed annual
nominal rate of 7.5% and Class&nbsp;XXXIX NO accrue and pay interest semiannually at a fixed annual nominal rate of 8.75%. The integration of Class&nbsp;XXXVIII NO was made in kind with (i)&nbsp;Class&nbsp;XXV NO for 50, (ii) Class&nbsp;XXIX NO for
47, and (iii)&nbsp;Class&nbsp;XXXVI NO for 3, the remaining amount was integrated in cash. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Acquisition of Vaca Muerta Inversiones S.A.U.</U> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On August&nbsp;6, 2025, YPF entered into a share purchase agreement (the &#147;Agreement&#148;) with Total Austral S.A. whereby, subject to the
fulfillment of closing conditions set forth in the Agreement, YPF will acquire 100% of the shares and capital stock of Vaca Muerta Inversiones S.A.U. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The amount of the transaction is 500, subject to adjustments based on the cash flows of Vaca Muerta Inversiones S.A.U. between January 2025 and the
closing date of the transaction. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">If all the closing conditions set forth in the Agreement are fulfilled, YPF will become the sole owner and
shareholder of 100% of capital stock of Vaca Muerta Inversiones S.A.U., which will hold a 45% working interest in the La Escalonada and Rinc&oacute;n La Ceniza unconventional exploitation concessions in the Province of Neuqu&eacute;n. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">As of the date of issuance of these condensed interim consolidated financial statements, there have been no other significant subsequent events whose
effect on Group&#146;s financial position, results of operations or their disclosure in notes to the financial statements for the period ended as of June&nbsp;30, 2025, should have been considered in said financial statements under IFRS. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">These condensed interim consolidated financial statements were approved by the Board of Directors&#146; meeting and authorized to be issued on
August&nbsp;7, 2025. </P>

after applying for the relevant licenses as required by the regulatory framework, as well as the production, industrialization, processing, commercialization, conditioning, transportation and stockpiling of grains and products derived from grains,
as well as any other activity complementary to its industrial and commercial business or any activity which may be necessary to attain its object. To better achieve these purposes, it may set up, become associated with or have an interest in any

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><B><A NAME="otv10518_66"></A>1. GENERAL INFORMATION, STRUCTURE AND ORGANIZATION OF THE GROUP&#146;S
BUSINESS </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>General information</U> </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">YPF S.A.
(&#147;YPF&#148; or the &#147;Company&#148;) is a stock corporation<I> </I>(s<I>ociedad an&oacute;nima</I>) incorporated under the Argentine laws, with a registered office at Macacha G&uuml;emes 515, in the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">YPF and its subsidiaries (the &#147;Group&#148;) form the leading energy group in Argentina, which operates a fully integrated oil and gas chain with
leading market positions across the domestic Upstream, Midstream and Downstream LNG and Integrated Gas and New Energies business segments (see Note 6). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Structure and organization of the economic group</U> </P>

areas in Bolivia and sells natural gas, lubricants and derivatives in Chile. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><B><A NAME="otv10518_67"></A>2. &#8201;BASIS OF PREPARATION OF THE
CONDENSED INTERIM CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><B>2.a) Applicable accounting framework </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The condensed interim consolidated financial statements of the Company for the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> period ended
June&nbsp;30, 2025, are presented in accordance with IAS 34 &#147;Interim financial reporting&#148;. Therefore, they should be read together with the annual consolidated financial statements of the Company as of December&nbsp;31, 2024 (&#147;annual
consolidated financial statements&#148;) presented in accordance with IFRS Accounting Standards as issued by the IASB. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Moreover, some additional
information required by the LGS and/or CNV&#146;s Rules have been included. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">These condensed interim consolidated financial statements corresponding
to the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> period ended June&nbsp;30, 2025, are unaudited. The Company believes they include all necessary adjustments to reasonably present the results of each period on a basis consistent with the
audited annual consolidated financial statements. Net Income for the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> period ended June&nbsp;30, 2025 does not necessarily reflect the proportion of the Group&#146;s full-year net income. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><B>2.b) Material accounting policies </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The material
accounting policies are described in Note 2.b) to the annual consolidated financial statements. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The accounting policies adopted in the preparation of
these condensed interim consolidated financial statements are consistent with those used in the preparation of the annual consolidated financial statements, except for the valuation policy for income tax detailed in Note 19. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Functional and presentation currency</U> </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">As
mentioned in Note 2.b.1) to the annual consolidated financial statements, YPF has defined the U.S. dollar as its functional currency. Additionally, in accordance with the provisions of the LGS and the CNV rules, the Company must present its
financial statements in pesos. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Business combinations</U> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The Group analyzes whether the assets acquired and liabilities assumed in a purchase transaction qualify as a business combination in accordance with IFRS
3 &#147;Business combinations&#148;. Business combinations are accounted for using the acquisition method, which requires, among others, the recognition and measurement at fair value of the identifiable assets acquired, the liabilities assumed and
any <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-controlling</FONT> interest. The excess of the consideration transferred over such fair value is recognized as goodwill and the shortfall as a gain in profit or loss for the period. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">When the assets acquired are not a business, the Group accounts for the transaction as the acquisition of an asset. </P>

</B></P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Adoption of new standards and interpretations effective as from January&nbsp;1, 2025 </U></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Standards and interpretations issued by the IASB whose application is not mandatory at the closing date of these condensed interim consolidated

application of the IFRS and/or their amendments is not permitted for issuers filing financial statements with the CNV, unless specifically admitted by such agency. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><B>2.c) Significant estimates and key sources of estimation uncertainty </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">In preparing the financial statements at a certain date, the Group is required to make estimates and assessments affecting the amount of assets and
liabilities recorded and the contingent assets and liabilities disclosed at such date, as well as income and expenses recognized in the fiscal year or period. Actual future profit or loss might differ from the estimates and assessments made at the
date of preparation of these condensed interim consolidated financial statements. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The assumptions relating to the future and other key sources of
uncertainty about the estimates made for the preparation of these condensed interim consolidated financial statements are consistent with those used by the Group in the preparation of the annual consolidated financial statements, which are disclosed
in Note 2.c) to the annual consolidated financial statements. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><B>2.d) Comparative information </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Amounts and other financial information corresponding to the fiscal year ended December&nbsp;31, 2024 and for the
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> period ended June&nbsp;30, 2024 are an integral part of these condensed interim consolidated financial statements and are intended to be read only in relation to these financial statements. Likewise,
changes have been made to the comparative figures in Notes 6 and 26 as mentioned in Note 6. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B><A NAME="otv10518_68"></A>3. &#8201;SEASONALITY OF OPERATIONS </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Historically, the Group&#146;s results have been subject to seasonal fluctuations throughout the year, particularly as a result of the increase in natural
gas sales during the winter driven by the increased demand in the residential segment. Consequently, the Group is subject to seasonal fluctuations in its sales volumes and prices, with higher sales of natural gas during the winter at higher prices.
</P> <P STYLE="font-size:8pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The most relevant acquisitions and disposals of companies that took place during the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> period ended
June&nbsp;30, 2025 are described below: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Acquisition of Mobil Argentina S.A. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On December&nbsp;17, 2024, the Company entered into a share purchase and sale agreement with ExxonMobil Argentina Upstream B.V., ExxonMobil Exploration
and Production Gemini B.V., and QatarEnergy Argentina Holdings LLC (collectively, the &#147;Sellers&#148;) whereby, subject to the fulfillment of closing conditions set forth in such agreement, YPF acquired 100% of the shares and capital stock of
Mobil Argentina S.A. (&#147;MASA&#148;). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">MASA owns 54.45% of Sierra Chata unconventional exploitation concession in the Province of Neuqu&eacute;n.
Pampa Energ&iacute;a S.A., operator of such concession, owns the remaining working interest. </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Sale of equity participation in YPF Brasil Com&eacute;rcio Derivado de Petr&oacute;leo Ltda. (&#147;YPF Brasil&#148;)</U> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On January&nbsp;31, 2025, after the fulfillment of the closing conditions of the share purchase and sale agreement of the subsidiary YPF Brasil, the sale
and transfer by YPF to the GMZ HOLDING LTDA. and IGP HOLDING PARTICIPA&Ccedil;&Otilde;ES S.A., with the intervention of USIQU&Iacute;MICA DO BRASIL LTDA. as guarantor of the transaction, of 100% of the shares and capital stock of YPF Brasil was
completed. The sale price of the transaction was US$ 2.3&nbsp;million. See Note 3 &#147;Sale of equity participation in YPF Brasil Com&eacute;rcio Derivado de Petr&oacute;leo Ltda. (&#147;YPF Brasil&#148;)&#148; section to the annual consolidated
financial statements. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Based on the closing of the aforementioned share purchase and sale agreement and considering the fair value of the assets and
liabilities of YPF Brasil classified as held for sale, as of the closing date of the transaction, the result from the sale did not have significant effects. In addition, the translation differences accumulated in the &#147;Other comprehensive
income&#148; account and reclassified to the profit or loss due to the loss of control of the subsidiary amounted to a loss of 851. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Acquisition of
equity participation of OLCLP</U> </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On January&nbsp;31, 2025 the Company entered into a share purchase and sale agreement with Tecpetrol S.A. whereby,
subject to the fulfillment of closing conditions set forth in such agreement, YPF acquired 15% of the shares and capital stock of OLCLP joint venture. On June&nbsp;4, 2025 (&#147;acquisition date&#148;), after the fulfillment of the closing
conditions, the sale and transfer by Tecpetrol S.A. to YPF of 15% of the shares and capital stock of OLCLP was completed. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">As of the acquisition date,
YPF, which owned 85% of the capital stock of OLCLP prior to the share purchase and sale agreement mentioned above, is the sole owner and shareholder of 100% of capital stock of OLCLP. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The amount of the transaction was US$ 15&nbsp;million, which was cancelled by offsetting payment obligations assumed by Tecpetrol S.A. under a firm
transportation services agreement for the &#147;Vaca Muerta Sur&#148; Pipeline of US$ 13.6&nbsp;million, and the remaining balance of US$ 1.4&nbsp;million in cash. </P>

FINANCIAL RISK MANAGEMENT </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The Group&#146;s activities expose it to a variety of financial risks: Market risk (including exchange rate
risk, interest rate risk, and price risk), liquidity risk and credit risk. Within the Group, risk management functions are conducted in relation to financial risks associated to financial instruments to which the Group is exposed during a certain
period or as of a specific date. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">During the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> period ended June&nbsp;30, 2025, there were no
significant changes in the administration or policies of risk management implemented by the Group as described in Note 4 to the annual consolidated financial statements. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:ARIAL; font-size:9pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<P STYLE="margin-top:10pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Most of the Group&#146;s loans contain market-standard covenants for contracts of this nature, which include financial covenants in respect of the
Group&#146;s leverage ratio and debt service coverage ratio, and events of defaults triggered by materially adverse judgements, among others. See Notes 17, 33 and 34 to the annual consolidated financial statements and Notes 18 and 34. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The Group monitors compliance with covenants on a quarterly basis. As of June&nbsp;30, 2025, the Group is in compliance with its covenants. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B><A NAME="otv10518_71"></A>6. BUSINESS SEGMENT INFORMATION </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The
different business segments in which the Group&#146;s organization is structured consider the different activities from which the Group can obtain revenues and incur expenses. Such organizational structure is based on the way in which the chief
decision maker analyzes the main operating and financial magnitudes for making decisions about resource allocation and performance assessment, also considering the business strategy of the Group. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Business segment information is presented in U.S. dollars, the functional currency of the Company (see Note 2.b)), consistently with the manner of
reporting the information used by the chief decision maker to allocate resources and assess business segment performance. </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B>6. BUSINESS SEGMENT INFORMATION (cont.) </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">As of the current fiscal year, as a consequence of the organizational structure changes in which the New Energies Vice Presidency was created, and the Gas
and Power Vice Presidency and the Downstream Vice Presidency were reformulated as the LNG and Integrated Gas Vice Presidency and the Midstream and Downstream Vice Presidency respectively, the complete management scope of these new business units was
determined. On January&nbsp;1, 2025, these organizational changes resulted in a modification of the composition of the business segments according to how the chief decision maker allocates resources and assesses the performance of these business
segments, creating the New Energies business segment and readjusting the composition and definition of the businesses of the remaining business segments. The changes in the business segments had no impact on the CGUs defined in Note 2.b.5) to the
annual consolidated financial statements. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">As aforementioned and in Note 5 to the annual consolidated financial statements, the comparative
information for the fiscal year ended December&nbsp;31, 2024 and the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> period ended June&nbsp;30, 2024 has been restated. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The business segments structure is organized as follows: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:ARIAL; font-size:9pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="justify" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:ARIAL; font-size:9pt"><B>Upstream </B></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:10pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:3%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The Upstream business segment performs all activities related to the exploration and exploitation of hydrocarbon fields and production of
crude oil and natural gas. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:3%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On July&nbsp;1, 2024, certain assets related to the production of frac sand for well drilling/fracking
purposes, which were formerly included in the Upstream business segment, were assigned to Central Administration and Others. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:3%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Its
revenues are mainly derived from: (i)&nbsp;the sale of the produced crude oil to the Midstream and Downstream business segment; (ii)&nbsp;the sale of the produced natural gas to the LNG and Integrated Gas business segment; and (iii)&nbsp;the sale of
the natural gas retained in plant to the Midstream and Downstream business segment. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:3%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">It incurs all costs related to the aforementioned
activities. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:10pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:3%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The Midstream and Downstream business segment performs activities related to: (i)&nbsp;the refining, transportation and commercialization
of refined products; (ii)&nbsp;the production, transportation and commercialization of petrochemical products; (iii)&nbsp;the transportation and commercialization of crude oil; and (iv)&nbsp;the commercialization of specialties for the agribusiness
industry and of grains and their <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">by-products.</FONT> </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:3%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On January&nbsp;1, 2025, as a consequence of
the organizational changes described above, the assets related to the natural gas transportation, the conditioning and processing of natural gas retained in plant for the separation and fractionation of gasoline, propane and butane, the storage of
the produced natural gas, and the commercial and technical operation of the LNG regasification terminal in Escobar, which were formerly included in the Gas and Power business segment, were assigned to the Midstream and Downstream business segment.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:3%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Its revenues are mainly derived from the sale of crude oil, refined and petrochemical products, and specialties for agribusiness
industry and grains and their <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">by-products,</FONT> through the businesses of B2C (Retail), B2B (Commercial Networks, Industries, Transportation, Aviation, Agro, Lubricants and Specialties), LPG, Chemicals,
International Trade and Transportation and Sales to Companies. In addition, it obtains revenues from midstream oil, midstream gas and natural gas storage operations and the provision of LNG regasification services. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:3%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">It incurs all costs related to the aforementioned activities, including the purchase of: (i)&nbsp;crude oil from the Upstream business
segment and third parties; (ii)&nbsp;natural gas to be consumed in the refinery and petrochemical industrial complexes from the LNG and Integrated Gas business segment; and (iii)&nbsp;natural gas retained in plant from the Upstream business segment.

<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:8pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><B>NOTES TO THE CONDENSED INTERIM CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS</B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:8pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><B>AS OF JUNE 30, 2025 AND COMPARATIVE INFORMATION (UNAUDITED)</B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:1pt; font-size:8pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">(Amounts expressed in millions of Argentine pesos, except for shares and per share amounts expressed in Argentine pesos, or as otherwise

<TD VALIGN="top" ALIGN="right">

</TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:10pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B>6. BUSINESS SEGMENT INFORMATION (cont.) </B></P>
<p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:ARIAL; font-size:9pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>&#149;</B></TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="justify" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:ARIAL; font-size:9pt"><B>LNG and Integrated Gas </B></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:10pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The LNG and Integrated Gas business segment performs activities related to: (i)&nbsp;natural gas commercialization to third parties and
to the Midstream and Downstream business segment; (ii)&nbsp;the separation of natural gas liquids and their fractionation, storage and transportation for the production of ethane, propane, butane and gasoline, and its commercialization, through our
investment in joint venture Mega; and (iii)&nbsp;the development of LNG capacity. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On January&nbsp;1, 2025, as a consequence of the
organizational changes described above, the assets related to the natural gas transportation, the conditioning and processing of natural gas retained in plant for the separation and fractionation of gasoline, propane and butane, the storage of the
produced natural gas, and the commercial and technical operation of the LNG regasification terminal in Escobar, which were formerly included in the Gas and Power business segment, were assigned to the Midstream and Downstream business segment.
Furthermore, the assets related to the distribution of natural gas through our subsidiary Metrogas, the generation of conventional thermal electric power and renewable energy, and the production, storage, distribution and sale of fertilizers through
our investments in associates and joint ventures, which were formerly included in the Gas and Power business segment, were assigned to the New Energies business segment. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Its revenues are mainly derived from the commercialization of natural gas as producers to third parties and to the Midstream and
Downstream and the New Energies business segments. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">It incurs all costs related to the aforementioned activities, including the
purchase of natural gas from the Upstream business segment. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:ARIAL; font-size:9pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>&#149;</B></TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="justify" STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:ARIAL; font-size:9pt"><B>New Energies </B></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:10pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">On January&nbsp;1, 2025, as a consequence of the organizational changes described above, the New Energies Vice Presidency was created and
during the current fiscal year the complete management scope of this new business unit was determined. As of that date, the assets related to the distribution of natural gas through our subsidiary Metrogas, the generation of conventional thermal
electric power and renewable energy and the production, storage, distribution and sale of fertilizers through our investments in associates and joint ventures, which were formerly included in the Gas and Power business segment, were assigned to the
New Energies business segment. In addition, the assets related to the provision of research and development services of technology applied to the hydrocarbon industry through our subsidiary <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Y-TEC,</FONT> previously
included in Central Administration and Others, were assigned to the New Energies business segment. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The New Energies business segment
performs activities related to: (i)&nbsp;the definition and development of the new energy portfolio; (ii)&nbsp;the definition and development of sustainability and energy transitions programs; (iii)&nbsp;the distribution of natural gas through our
subsidiary Metrogas; and (iv)&nbsp;the provision of research and development services of technology applied to the hydrocarbon industry through our subsidiary <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Y-TEC.</FONT> Furthermore, through our investments in
associates and joint ventures, the New Energies business segment performs activities related to: (i)&nbsp;the generation of conventional thermal electric power and renewable energy; and (ii)&nbsp;the production, storage, distribution and sale of
fertilizers. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Its revenues are mainly derived from the sale of natural gas through our subsidiary Metrogas. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:2%; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">It incurs all costs related to the aforementioned activities, including the purchase of natural gas from the LNG and Integrated Gas
business segment. </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><U>Cerro Piedra - Cerro Guadal Norte, Barranca Yankowsky, Los Monos, El Guadal - Lomas del Cuy, Ca&ntilde;ad&oacute;n Vasco, Ca&ntilde;ad&oacute;n Yatel,
